output.explanation: A visit row is valid unless it is a close-out visit (visit_type "COV") that still has open issues. Visits of any other type, or with no visit_type, are not checked. A "COV" visit passes only if open_issues is present and exactly 0.
fails_when: visit_type is "COV" and open_issues is greater than 0.
visit_type is "COV" and open_issues is negative, because only exactly 0 passes.
visit_type is "COV" and open_issues is null. A missing count fails rather than being treated as zero, which may be surprising.
visit_type is a different case such as "cov". It counts as not "COV", so it passes without any open_issues check.
passes_when: visit_type is null (the other checks are skipped).
visit_type is anything other than "COV" (compared case-sensitively), whatever open_issues is, including null.
